title: Turku Collegium for Science, Medicine and Technology - Call for Applications 2027
institution: University of Turku, Turku Collegium for Science, Medicine and Technology (TCSMT)
about: University of Turku TCSMT 2027 call for postdoctoral and Collegium researcher positions in science, medicine and technology. Open 1 November 2026 to 15 January 2027 (16:00 Finnish time) via the university's electronic form. Evaluation by 19 February; starts 1 September to 1 December 2027.
requirements: Postdoctoral positions: doctoral degree no more than five years old at the deadline
Collegium researcher positions: doctoral degree three to nine years old (family leave, military service excluded)

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy course catalog
why: The call covers science, medicine and technology broadly and states only doctoral-degree timing requirements; no course objective genuinely covers them, so the post links to the Academy catalog.
